threat_model.threat_source: High-volition AGI; the passage also refers to 'one or many wealthy AGIs' that dominate the civilization
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Humanity may find itself a pauper in a civilization dominated by one or many wealthy AGIs (explicitly described harmful end state; no intention is stated for the AGI, so this is a harmful outcome rather than an objective)
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: The outcome is explicitly conditional on the premise 'If high-volition AGI persistently outcompetes humans' — persistent (sustained) outcompetition by a high-volition AGI is the stated condition for the harm to occur
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Humanity ('humanity may find itself a pauper'); the civilization ('a civilization dominated by one or many wealthy AGIs')
